newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Feb CPI up 4.3 pct yr/yr, up 0.5 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Thai Feb CPI up 4.3 pct yr/yr, up 0.5 pct mth/mth.

text.p: The Thai consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.3 percent year-on-year in February, unchanged from January, the Commerce Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said the 1990-based index rose to 137.3 in February from its 131.6 level in the same month a year ago.
The Thai Commerce Ministry issued the following economic indicators:
THAI CONSUMER PRICE Feb 97 Jan 97 Feb 96

NOTES: In the food and beverage category, vegetables and fruit prices surged 4.0 percent in February from January and bread and flour products rose 3.4 percent. Eggs and dairy products, however, eased 1.2 percent month-on-month.
In the non-food group, costs of medical checks and personal care services increased 0.3 percent, and housing prices gained 0.2 percent.
